does.ms: Menjanjikan duit mudah yang terlalu besar.
does.en: Promises easy money that is far too big.

cue.en: RM300 a day, work from home

tip.ms: Kalau tawaran nampak terlalu bagus, berhenti sekejap dan tanya: kenapa mereka beri sebanyak ini? Kerja sebenar jarang bayar setinggi itu untuk kerja semudah itu.
tip.en: If an offer looks too good, stop for a moment and ask: why would they pay this much? Real jobs rarely pay that high for work that easy.

tip.ms: Penipu tak mahu kamu berfikir lama. Ambil masa, tanya orang yang kamu percaya, dan tawaran yang betul akan masih ada.
tip.en: Scammers don't want you thinking for long. Take your time, ask someone you trust, and a real offer will still be there.

does.ms: Berpura-pura jadi polis, mahkamah atau bank.
does.en: Pretends to be the police, a court or a bank.

cue.ms: Saya Inspektor dari ibu pejabat polis
cue.en: I'm an Inspector from police headquarters

tip.ms: Pihak berkuasa sebenar tak urus kes melalui telefon atau minta kamu pindah duit. Letak telefon, dan hubungi sendiri nombor rasmi mereka.
tip.en: Real authorities don't handle cases over the phone or ask you to move money. Hang up, and call their official number yourself.

does.ms: Mengugut tangkapan, denda atau akaun disekat.
does.en: Threatens arrest, fines or a blocked account.

tip.ms: Rasa takut itu normal, ia memang cara penipu bekerja. Tarik nafas, putuskan panggilan, dan semak sendiri dengan pihak yang sebenar.
tip.en: Feeling scared is normal; that is exactly how scammers work. Breathe, end the call, and check with the real organisation yourself.

does.ms: Mengasingkan mangsa daripada nasihat orang lain.
does.en: Cuts the victim off from other people's advice.

tip.ms: Urusan yang betul tak perlu dirahsiakan. Beritahu keluarga atau kawan; mereka sering nampak apa yang kita terlepas.
tip.en: Proper dealings don't need to be secret. Tell family or friends; they often see what we miss.

does.ms: Menggunakan testimoni dan kawan palsu untuk meyakinkan.
does.en: Uses fake testimonials and friends to convince you.

tip.ms: Gambar, komen dan angka boleh dipalsukan dengan mudah. Cari maklumat daripada sumber bebas, bukan dari mesej yang menjual kepada kamu.
tip.en: Pictures, comments and numbers are easy to fake. Look for information from independent sources, not from the message selling to you.

does.ms: Meminta yuran, top-up atau akses akaun dahulu.
does.en: Asks for a fee, top-up or account access up front.

tip.ms: Kerja dan hadiah yang sebenar tak minta kamu bayar dulu. Bila ada permintaan bayaran sebelum apa-apa, itulah tanda untuk berhenti.
tip.en: Real jobs and prizes don't ask you to pay first. When someone wants payment before anything else, that is your sign to stop.
